name: UPV no-cooling: exploratory post-event CUDA source

metadata.calibration_status: UNFITTED geometry-only pressure-feedback diagnostic; v10 coefficients are obsolete priors
metadata.validation_scope: Conditional post-event solid response to prescribed primary failure and measured environment
metadata.geometry_status: layer thickness/order incl. outer ISS4 from Fig.2/Table3; full-face areas and fixture extent assumed
metadata.topology_status: UNCONFIRMED acquisition-numbering hypothesis: C3 left, C1 right; contradicts Fig.2 witness labels; Table5 material sides retained
metadata.window_rule: Fixed 300 seconds after last pre-event sample
assumptions: surface thermocouples compared to reconstructed face means; exact coordinates unavailable
C2 upper/lower measurements averaged on each face
ISS, TIM, aluminium and steel modeled with full cell face area
pressure plates assumed same face dimensions as cell; resin holders omitted
baseline h=100 W/m2/K; calibration may distinguish material-pair contacts; environmental h is effective
cooled case: ch110 imposed on all three spreader tips; spatial uniformity unverified
l0=1e-4 m is an order-parameter convention, NOT identified by this fit
Fixed working cp: ISS 770, TIM 1175, Al 900, steel 500 J/kg/K; pad composition-specific cp unverified
Directed log connectivity: sender polynomial plus signed temperature/damage contrasts; no endpoint averaging
Contact h bounded 1..10000 W/m2/K; these are engineering bounds, not material measurements
Destruction branch and damage kinetics are NOT identifiable from pre-event data
metadata.execution: Native viewer/headless directly. Do not reapply calibration probe scales to this exported scene.

core_shell_grid.definition: One numerical layer on ALL six exterior faces; not a measured casing thickness

links_protocol.fixed: ALL capacities (battery C=412.87 J/K), reference k tensors, external temperature/contrast response, geometry, cooling/ambient boundaries, source forcing, sensors, defects
links_protocol.selection: No-cooling finite perturbations: battery/ISS and ISS/aluminium sensitive; saturated TIM contacts weakly observable. No validation-guided selection.
links_protocol.bounds_note: Remove prior factor-two trust box for battery/ISS; keep the existing physical-model h ceiling. Exploratory bounds, not measured material intervals.
links_protocol.regularization: 0.03 K RMS per internal log-response slope difference, unchanged from previous transport fit
links_protocol.caveat: Pre-event conditional graph fit, not runaway/defect calibration or measured bulk k(T). Numbering unconfirmed; validation previously inspected. Mesh remains 3^3.
links_protocol.internal_response: tabulated(T_donor) + beta*(T_donor-T_receiver)/100 K; never average directions
links_protocol.development_note: Additional constitutive trial after inspecting reference-contact trial validation; not blind model selection

gas_energy_protocol.gas: Common effective ideal-gas R=287 and cv=1000 before/after reaction; no species/mole-count, CFD, radiation or acoustic wave solver
gas_energy_protocol.reaction: Gas assumed ignited when fuel arrives; rate 20/s fixed. Oxygen heat 13.1 MJ/kg is a conventional-fuel proxy, NOT a battery-gas measurement
gas_energy_protocol.oxidizer: Initially .232 mass fraction in chamber; absent from initial cell gas and generated gas; finite inventory advected and consumed, total gas mass unchanged
gas_energy_protocol.source: Frozen event-conditioned initial fields; tied solid reaction rates fitted; finite net heat split into solid and gas chemical potential, no extra energy source
gas_energy_protocol.wall: Lumped stainless-wall proxy, volume/area of equivalent 120 L cube, 2 mm steel, rho=8000, cp=500, outer h=5 W/m2K to initial chamber T; geometry/thickness NOT measured
gas_energy_protocol.thermal: All ambient-* boundaries REPLACED by conservative chamber-to-surface contacts. Measured hot ch109 is diagnostic only, not an energy input. Cooling sink ch110 retained
gas_energy_protocol.contacts: Frozen intact material/capacity laws and residue factors; one common exposure multiplier, no per-sensor offsets
gas_energy_protocol.objective: Equal-size-normalized blocks: p(0..30s)/0.25bar, p(30..1800s)/0.05bar; four late witness residuals/5K each. Original scans; no onset-time fit
gas_energy_protocol.status: Exploratory joint fit, not validated ignition/combustion physics; held-out experiment was inspected in earlier development

progressive_shell_protocol.frozen: All v7 solid/gas energy, gas yield, chemistry, free volume, wall/exposure, thermal properties, sensors and initial fields
progressive_shell_protocol.area: Total effective area distributed by panel face area over six C2 panels; not recovered fracture geometry
progressive_shell_protocol.routing: Single chamber receiving compartment is an effective peripheral escape path, including discharge from covered faces; no resolved interfacial gas gap or jet. Thermal solid contacts are retained, not bypassed.
progressive_shell_protocol.scope: Conditional primary C2 event only, not prediction of ignition or cascade; C1/C3 remain the previous thermal witnesses
progressive_shell_protocol.identifiability: Only chamber pressure observed; seam geometry/ratio fixed priors, not measured or identified weld data
progressive_shell_protocol.objective: Equal-size-normalized blocks: p(0..30s)/0.25bar, p(30..1800s)/0.05bar; four late witness residuals/5K each. Original scans; no onset-time fit
progressive_shell_protocol.validation_note: Previously inspected experiment, excluded from all parameter selection; not blind validation

aperture_calibration_protocol.energy: Surface heat debited from arriving gas enthalpy; opening work debited from internal gas and stored in its own ledger
aperture_calibration_protocol.aperture_priors: h=1e4 W/m2/K, work=1e3 J/m2 are exploratory priors; search bounds are NOT independently established material-property intervals
aperture_calibration_protocol.identifiability: Sensitivity on training record before selection; flat coefficients are frozen and explicitly marked unidentifiable
aperture_calibration_protocol.validation_note: Previously inspected experiment, excluded from parameter selection; not blind or independent-laboratory validation
aperture_calibration_protocol.measurement_note: Same historical unconfirmed witness numbering; burst thermocouples diagnostic only, no channel offsets or fitted time shifts
